pool.text: Copper temple structures constructed during the Wanli reign period of Ming dynasty.
Wu Shifan resisted Qing forces before committing suicide, reverting city control.
Modern prosperity began when the French built the Kunming-Haiphong railway.
Local warlord General Tang Jiyao established the Wujiaba Aerodrome in Kunming.
Kunming's zoo was founded and is adjoined to Yuantong Park.
The city government ordered young people to tear down the wall bricks.
Kunming University of Science and Technology was established in Kunming.
The camellia was confirmed by the Municipality of Kunming as its city flower.
The State Council approved Kunming as an Open City.
Yunnan Ethnology Museum was opened in Kunming.
World Horti-Expo Garden was built for the World Horticulture Exposition.
The second Greater Mekong Subregion Summit was held in Kunming.
Kunming Natural History Museum of Zoology opened in November.
Explosions aboard two public buses in downtown Kunming killed two people.
A research paper proposes that the name Kunming means people.
Kunming city government built a master-planned new city center in Chenggong.
Kunming Changshui International Airport opened, replacing the older international airport.
Twenty-nine people were killed at Kunming Railway Station in a terrorist attack.
Kunming South railway station opened in Chenggong District.
Kunming has served as a cargo distribution center for the China-Laos Railway.
